comments.note: [documentation-forward] DiffBrushes.xaml has an intentional naming asymmetry in foreground brushes that future contributors will need explained: 3 sidebar card icons reuse the diff-list foreground brushes (DiffBrush.RemovedForeground, DiffBrush.InsertedForeground, DiffBrush.AddedForeground), while 2 sidebar cards require distinct Guidance-prefixed keys (DiffBrush.GuidanceReplacementForeground, DiffBrush.GuidanceMovedForeground) because their icon color differs from the corresponding diff-list icon. A code comment in DiffBrushes.xaml immediately above the foreground section explaining this rule ('sidebar cards with a unique color get a Guidance* key; those sharing the diff-list color reuse the plain key') would prevent future misclassification. The Documentation agent should add this inline comment.

No blocking issues found. The implementation is a minimal, correct XAML resource consolidation. DynamicResource is correctly used throughout (consistent with all other brush references in DiffWindow.xaml) and allows runtime theme-switching. All acceptance criteria are independently verified by both implementation artifacts and QA scan results.
